_note: Arrow wounds on netch and seekers: shafts sunk in soft, floating hide, fluid leaking. Overrides the arrow source over common.json. Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.

levels: , the point sinking into the soft hide with a wet pop. {name} pulses and recoils, the shaft bobbing.
, the arrowhead tearing in where the hide is already torn. Fluid spills down the shaft and {name} lets out a deep, hollow moan.
, and the arrow rips the wound wide. Fluid gushes and {name} spins and thrashes, tentacles whipping.
, and it is too much. {name} sinks low, arrows hanging from the hide, leaking and limp, tentacles trailing on the ground.
